title: Sizing comment cites the 2026-05-04 incident as evidence retries absorb cold starts, but that history documents the retry budget being burned
evidence:
production.tfvars:14-15: "# retries (3 attempts, 2/8/32s backoff, ~42s runway) absorb the cold-start
# blips this can reintroduce (see variables.tf 2026-05-04 history and
# staging's identical move)." — vs variables.tf:149-152: "start. Historical context: staging hit cold-start
    `session_create:connection_failure` on 2026-05-04 (19:07, 22:57, 23:49,
    01:52, 07:07) when min=0 — Gleam's HTTP client timed out before the new
    instance finished booting and burned its retry budget."
detail: The cited history is the counter-example: on 2026-05-04 retries were exhausted, not absorbing. Real absorbing evidence is staging's live min=0 record (#152) and measured 27.7s cold-start session-create (tests/load_test/baselines/2026-04-18-phase2-vertex-sessions/README.md:26) vs 42s runway.
recommended_fix: Reword to attribute absorption to staging's post-#152 live record and the 27.7s-measured cold start vs 42s backoff runway, keeping variables.tf as the record of what the blips are.
